messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing 'quiet-rollout quorum' + auto fallback scoring for canaries/A-Bs. Need clear gates and an ops playbook.

tyler: Agree. Propose p95 latency delta <20% AND error-rate delta <0.1% vs cohort baseline.

eva: Add 120s quiesce after flag flip per cohort before we evaluate to avoid warmup noise.

jamal: Include customer-impact weighting so big tenants trigger faster action; also tenant opt-out.

eva: Draft config example:
`{quiesce_seconds:120, ramps:[0.5,5,20,100], eval_metrics:[p95_latency,error_rate,hallucination_rate], min_samples:200, auto_pause:40, auto_rollback:70}`

tyler: Ramp windows: 30m per step. If score>40 pause ramp; if >=70 immediate rollback.

maria: Ops playbook: mark cohort quiescing 120s, evaluate 1m rolling windows, if 40-70 pause+notify+#oncall, collect traces; if >=70 auto-rollback+page. Add bypass_quiesce role for infra and tenant_opt_out for CS.

eva: Telemetry: per-cohort timeseries of final score and contributor breakdown; UI buttons for pause/resume/rollback.

maria: I'll draft full spec with pseudocode and open PR for Console/CLI flags. Ping for review. :thumbsup:
